presentation:
Hi! I'm a {age, number} software developer and tinkerer from Italy. Here you can find a portfolio of cool projects I've worked on over the years, both for work and for my own fun. I have been coding since I was 14, starting with C in high school.
I then started to look around beyond that and begun many small personal projects, messing with everything from Pascal to Go, from Python to Javascript, from C# to Nim, from Unity to Godot, an amazing open source game engine - and doing game dev got me some experience with Blender as well.
Now, when I'm not doing work with Vue and Laravel, I'm either messing around with either Godot or managing the several services I'm self hosting on my own home server.
